summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.5 -- Dell Class-B Provisioning Continuation Execution. Real-host execution against hac-dell. Reverified chgr-541cb08c313b4f8884970172d37c5a1d currency and its binding to governing session CDS-554c3c12-0693-4edd-867d-b86374c376b2 (not the superseded CDS-8984cecc-...); explicitly recorded non-use of the old CHGR chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832; reverified Dell machine-id, pinned source SHA, credential prerequisite, and all five retained Actions-1-5 continuation gates -- all exact, no repair. Executed repaired Action 6 (clone + detached checkout at the pinned SHA 7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a, two-branch find -perm -u+x mode repair) -- independently verified clean across all 4030 tracked paths (4024x0640, 6x0750, zero mismatches), zero content drift, clean git status. Executed unchanged Action 7 (venv + editable install of pcae-harness) and Action 8 (launch wrapper, SHA-256 exact match b3e969128ff48ecfae874a9348d889b43f7fc336bf170387b912b1cfc3753c32) -- both independently verified clean. Action 9 (read-only) FAILED adjudication: authorized residual was exactly {HBDC-REQ-042}; actual measured failing set was {HBDC-REQ-022, HBDC-REQ-030, HBDC-REQ-035, HBDC-REQ-036, HBDC-REQ-042} -- four unexpected failures. Per the governing instruction's own section 41: STOPPED. No repair. No broadened authority. No DeploymentBinding, no certification, no activation. Read-only root-cause investigation (no mutation) traced HBDC-REQ-022/035 to a pre-existing verifier-source defect (importlib.metadata.distribution lookup key 'pcae' vs. the declared distribution name 'pcae-harness') and HBDC-REQ-036 to Action 9's own frozen command PATH excluding the venv bin directory -- neither implicates Action 6/7/8's own correctness, each independently verified clean on its own terms. Actions 6-8 are not rolled back -- none failed its own postcondition; only Action 9's broader measurement diverged, and Action 9 is read-only with nothing to roll back. New companion test module, 32 tests, 3 consecutive clean runs. Recommends 149O.20L.7D.6 -- Action-9 Unexpected Residual Diagnosis and Proposition Repair -- not 7E, since a clean 7D.5 execution was the stated precondition for recommending 7E and that precondition was not met.
